children.name: Siderastrea radians
children.description: Siderastrea radians, also known as the lesser starlet coral or the shallow-water starlet coral, is a stony coral in the family Siderastreidae.

children.name: Siderastrea siderea
children.description: Siderastrea siderea, commonly known as massive starlet coral or round starlet coral, is a stony coral in the family Siderastreidae.

children.name: Culicia australiensis Hoffmeister, 1933
children.description: Colony reptoid, composed of elongated individual corallites joined by stolons. Corallites cylindrical, with circular to elliptical calices (GCD: LCD = 1.0 - 1.1), and ≤ 6.8 mm in H. Calicular margin smooth. Epitheca smooth and thin. Septa hexamerally arranged in four cycles according to the formula: S 1 - 2> S 3> S 4 (48 septa). S 1 - 2 equal in width and bearing variable axial margin: sometimes smooth and in other cases dentate, both types extend to columella. S 3 equal to or 1 / 3 smaller than S 1 - 2, and bear a dentate axial margin. S 4 rudimentary, also having dentate axial margin. All septa non-exsert and closely packed. Fossa moderately deep containing a papillose columella composed of granulated rods.

children.name: Culicia excavata
children.description: Corallum colonial, reptoid, with short, cylindrical, and small individual corallites connected by stolons. Calice circular. Calicular margin smooth. Septa hexamerally arranged in three cycles according to the formula: S 1 - 2 ≥ S 3 (24 septa). S 1 - 2 equal in size, convex, and extend to an under-developed columella (if present) with slightly dentated axial margins. S 3 rudimentary and curved towards S 2 with dentate axial margins. Septa loosely packed. Pali absent. Columella rudimentary or absent. Fossa shallow.
